collision_rules: No actor edits another actor namespace.
No in-place overwrite of return/trace/receipt once published; create *_vN or new timestamped file.
Shared latest pointer may only point to immutable artifacts and must include sha256.
Every cross-read must cite handle + sha256 + changed_judgment or used_for.
Authority/current-position/registry/folder tree are read-only unless user separately approves apply.

log_namespaces.rule: Each actor writes only inside its own namespace. Shared handoff files are append-by-new-version only, never in-place rewritten.

purpose: Prevent Hermes execution-space setup logs and Codex space-maturation logs from colliding while allowing each side to immediately inspect the other side through stable handoff indexes.

if fresh space reference is needed, tells Codex what original/task to use and what not to mutate
